name: fast-gliner-compaction
description: Removal-first compaction for Claude Code sessions: old tool output is truncated unless it is expensive to get again, judged by rules and a self-hosted GLiNER2.5 classifier.

serverUrl.title: Decision server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the fast-gliner-compaction server (local or a GPU host). Leave unset to use FGC_SERVER_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8765.

serverToken.title: Decision server token
serverToken.description: Bearer token matching the server's FGC_TOKEN. Leave unset to use FGC_TOKEN from the environment.

model.title: Decision model
model.description: Model asked about tool calls the rules cannot classify: gliner-decide-1b (default), gliner-decide, gliner25-base, gliner25-multi, laya, ... The server loads it on first use unless FGC_LAZY=0.

spareThreshold.title: Spare threshold
spareThreshold.description: Minimum model probability that re-running a call would be expensive for its output to be kept. Higher removes more.

cheapTools.title: Extra cheap tools
cheapTools.description: Comma-separated tool-name globs whose output is always cheap to get again (truncated). Wins over the built-in rules.

expensiveTools.title: Extra expensive tools
expensiveTools.description: Comma-separated tool-name globs whose output is always kept. Wins over the built-in rules.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history; below it the built-in summary runs instead.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters kept from a removed tool result; 0 keeps only the note.

truncateInputChars.title: Truncated tool input fields
truncateInputChars.description: Characters kept of each long string input field (e.g. a Write's file content) of a call whose result was removed.

focusResultChars.title: Output shown to the model
focusResultChars.description: Characters of a tool result shown to the model when judging re-run cost.

maxRequestItems.title: Decisions per request
maxRequestItems.description: Tool calls scored per server request.
